# The Breathing Diabetic
> Science-based breathing for anxiety and diabetes management. By Nick Heath, Ph.D.

## About
Nick Heath, Ph.D. — breathing researcher, Type 1 diabetic, Certified Advanced Oxygen Advantage Instructor, Level I Pranayama Teacher. Author of "The Anxious Person's Breath Manual" (454 peer-reviewed studies synthesized). Publisher of The Breathing 411 newsletter for 7+ years.
